scientific_integrity: The proof distinguishes exact finite-sweep identities from limits; finite tests are consistency checks, not infinite certification. Existing general local Sinkhorn convergence rates are explicitly acknowledged. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only unrelaxed two-atom row-then-column scaling with positive symmetric off-diagonal kernel. The Riccati trajectory requires a fixed positive initial column multiplier ratio and marginal imbalance proportional to the off-diagonal kernel weight. No higher-dimensional, zero-kernel, adaptive-regularization, floating-point or absolute stopping-complexity assertion.
title: A near-disconnected Sinkhorn crossover with a Riccati flux profile
